## Table.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `striped` :: Shades every other body row.
- `hoverable` :: Lights a body row under the pointer. Turn off for dense reference tables.
- `density` :: Row density, on the shared ladder: `compact` · `cozy` · `comfortable`.
- `stickyHeader` :: Keeps the header row in view while the body scrolls. Pair it with `maxHeight`.
- `maxHeight` :: Caps the height and scrolls the body: a ladder word (`lg`) or any CSS length (`24rem`).
- `label` :: Names the scroll region for assistive technology and makes it keyboard-scrollable.
- `framed` :: Draws the frame around the table.
- `surface` :: The surface of that frame: fill, border and shadow in one choice.
- `shape` :: The corner treatment of the frame.
- `children` :: The table parts: `TableCaption`, `TableHead`, `TableBody`.

## TableBody.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `children` :: The body rows — `TableRow`s of `TableCell`s.

## TableCaption.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `visuallyHidden` :: Hides the caption visually while keeping it as the table's accessible name.
- `textSize` :: The scale of the caption text.
- `textColor` :: The ink of the caption text.
- `children` :: The caption text.

## TableCell.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `align` :: Horizontal alignment of the content.
- `numeric` :: A number: right-aligned with tabular numerals, so digits line up down the column.
- `muted` :: Secondary ink, for supporting values (dates, ids, units).
- `textColor` :: The ink used when `muted` is set.
- `children` :: The cell content — text, a number, a badge or a control; drawn in that column's track.

## TableHead.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `children` :: The header row — a `TableRow` of `TableHeader` cells.

## TableHeader.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `align` :: Horizontal alignment of the header text. Match it to the column's cells.
- `numeric` :: A numeric column: right-aligned, so it lines up with `numeric` cells.
- `width` :: A fixed column width (any CSS length, e.g. `8rem` or `20%`).
- `children` :: The header text.

## TableRow.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `selected` :: Marks the row as selected: it takes the selected fill. Say so in the row too (a checkbox, a label) for assistive technology.
- `children` :: The cells of the row, in column order.

## table.ts

### `type TableSize`

Row density of a table.

### `type TableAlign`

Horizontal alignment of a cell's content.

### `const densityClass`

The `.data-table` density modifier for a size.

### `const alignClass`

The text-alignment class for an alignment.

### `function cellAlign`

The alignment class for a cell: `align` when given, otherwise right for numbers and left for text.
